prior_importants.description: The radar block can now draw more rows than App reserves for it (append notes are never budgeted), so the frame can reach terminal height.

findings.description: Once the guaranteed pair row is set aside, the append-only notes take priority over the remaining pair rows. With 2+ real pairs and room 2 (e.g. `pup ui` over 3 projects, radarShare 2, live radar, two pairs each sharing src/x.ts and docs/adr/README.md), the note pushes out the only named pair. The block then reads `+2 more overlaps` plus the README note, and names no real overlap; before this PR it showed one OVERLAP row. Fix: reserve `Math.min(view.pairs.length, 2)` rows for the pairs before the notes.

The new Radar rendering test sits in the CLI command suite with a hand-written `textOf` element-tree walker, but Radar's component tests already live in src/cli/ui/dashboard-components.test.ts (rendered with ink-testing-library). Moving the case there would reuse `render`/`frameOf` and keep Radar's behaviour in one file (testing.md: one test file per source file).
